predicts: ticket type: Incident, Request, Problem, Change
input: ticket subject + body text only; no agent-added fields
trained_on: 11,670 English tickets, Kaggle 'Multilingual Customer Support Tickets' (aa_dataset-tickets-multi-lang-5-2-50-version.csv) — synthetic
evaluation: families of reworded tickets kept on one side of every split; test set opened once
known_limitations: Weakest type: Problem (recall 60%) — mostly confused with Incident; the labels themselves blur this line.
English only — German tickets were excluded and cannot be routed.
Synthetic data: results show the method works, not performance on a real inbox. Revalidate on real tickets before use.
The dataset's department labels were found unreliable (weakly related to text), so this model does not route to departments.
Short tickets (10 words or fewer) are noticeably less accurate.
